highlights: Patana Card or Visitor tag must be kept visible at all times
Designated Safeguarding Leads appointed for reporting concerns
Strict Parent Safeguarding Code of Conduct
Prohibition of cameras in privacy-expected areas such as toilets and changing rooms
safety.policy_summary: Bangkok Patana School maintains a comprehensive child protection and safeguarding policy designed to protect students and promote their well-being. Parents and visitors are required to follow a strict Code of Conduct while on campus, which includes wearing visible ID tags, respecting privacy and confidentiality regarding student information, and reporting any safeguarding concerns directly to the Designated Safeguarding Leads.
